QuestInfo.name: Humble Honor
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1022002##k's backside radiates Ambition. You can find #p1022002# in #b#m102000000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1022002# explains that Ambition isn't given--it's grasped. Follow #p1022002#'s example by hunting powerful monsters to build your Ambition. Defeat #r#o4230103#s#k.\n\n#o4230103##r #a295131##k

0.0: ...You seek strength, do you? To strive for power is admirable, but I wonder...do you have true Ambition?
0.1: Ambition means chasing your goals in earnest, no matter how difficult the road becomes. It has nothing to do with pride, or empty boasts of 'I eliminated this monster' or 'I defeated 200 of that monster.' But true Ambition, if you have it, will earn the respect of others without you having to say a word.
0.2: I've been hunting the nearby monsters. I get little from it, but I see it as my duty to help the defenseless townsfolk... Why don't you join me in this effort and help the people of #m102000000#?

yes.0: Yes, good. Eliminate some of the #r#o4230103#s#k? They've made travel to and from town difficult for most people... The people of #m102000000# would be appreciative if you eliminated about #r200#k of them.

no.0: Hmm... So, you do lack Ambition, after all...

1.0: You've taken care of the #o4230103#s? Ah... You do have some honor. I don't dislike people like you. Continue to stand at the forefront of battle, focused only on self-improvement...that is what it means to have true Ambition.

mob.0: Have you not eliminated 200 #o4230103#s yet? Do not place words before action.
